snippet.title: REFLECT89 — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist REFLECT89 on Steam:

Don't dodge it. Reflect it.

Explore REFLECT89 in the official gameplay trailer: reflect incoming attacks, face bosses, and discover power-ups and core upgrades across 50 levels spanning 1980–1989.
